Hi 

I am trying to use the visualization_sleep file to for errors in my sleep logs.  However, I can't read the file names on the left side of the page because they get cut off.  I have shortened the names, but I can't shorten them enough for them to display properly.  Any advice?  These are great graphs. i uploaded a photo to demonstrate my issue.  


thanks,

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] visualiation_sleep file
parts:
It looks like the participant id numbers were not succesfully extracted from the file names by which GGIR decided to use the file name as alternative file identifier. However, the visualisation is not designed to account for that.

Best solution is probably to either figure out how GGIR can extract the id number of your participants (argument idloc) or append the start of each filename with 12345_ where '12345' should be replaced by the id of the participant it belongs to. For the latter approach you will need to set idloc = 2 to make GGIR search for the id number in the filename preceding the first underscore.

Vincent
